claude.sample_unit: keywords (each tested with two prompt types)

links.outcome: Readability (FKRE, FKGL) of ChatGPT fragility fracture responses under two prompt types
links.effect: FKRE median 34.35 (plain language prompts) vs 23.60 (keyword-only); FKGL median 12.05 vs 14.50; both differences significant. Outputs remained at college-level difficulty.
links.quote: The FKRE scores indicated significantly higher readability with plain language prompts (median 34.35) compared to keyword-only prompts (median 23.60).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient materials on fragility fractures
links.effect: FKGL median 12.05 for plain language prompts and 14.50 for keyword-only prompts, above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: Similarly, the FKGL indicated a lower grade level for plain language prompts (median 12.05) versus keyword-only (median 14.50), with both differences achieving statistical significance.

unlisted_practices: Using descriptive plain-language conversational prompts rather than keyword-only prompts to improve readability of LLM patient education outputs

links.outcome: Readability and grade level of AI medical responses
links.effect: Plain-language prompts FKRE median 34.35 vs 23.60; FKGL median 12.05 vs 14.50; both statistically significant.
links.quote: The FKRE scores indicated significantly higher readability with plain language prompts (median 34.35) compared to keyword-only prompts (median 23.60).

links.outcome: Prompt wording effects on response readability
links.effect: Plain-language prompts FKRE median 34.35 vs keyword-only 23.60; prompt wording significantly changed readability.
links.quote: The FKRE scores indicated significantly higher readability with plain language prompts (median 34.35) compared to keyword-only prompts (median 23.60).

links.outcome: Readability and grade level of AI-generated responses
links.effect: Median FKGL was 12.05 for plain-language prompts versus 14.50 for keyword-only prompts, and median FKRE was 34.35 versus 23.60 (both differences statistically significant).
links.quote: Similarly, the FKGL indicated a lower grade level for plain language prompts (median 12.05) versus keyword-only (median 14.50), with both differences achieving statistical significance.

unlisted_practices: Using conversational or plain-language prompts instead of keywords to improve readability of generative AI outputs
